name: Lospikir

hero.headline:
Photographs that look
like the person,

statement: Most people arrive a little nervous. So we walk first, talk first, and start shooting once you have forgotten the camera is there — which is usually about ten minutes in.

investment.headline:
Pricing lives in
the brochure
investment.body: Every session is quoted on the date, the hours and the travel. Send me the details, or take the guide — it has every inclusion and the current investment.

enquire.headline:
Tell me what
you have in mind
enquire.body: A date, a rough location, the kind of session — that is enough to start. I reply to everything within a day or two.
enquire.success: Thank you — your message is in. I will come back to you within a day or two.
